# ghost/outdoor-food-calculator

Outdoor Food Calculator (F-Droid): plan food for a hike or trip. Set the trip length and type, add foods by weight and read the calories, protein, carbs, fat and fibre per day against your targets. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/outdoor-food-calculator
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/outdoor-food-calculator open_calculator --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/outdoor-food-calculator set_trip --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/outdoor-food-calculator add_food --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/outdoor-food-calculator get_totals --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_calculator`: Open the Outdoor Food Calculator app
- `set_trip`: Set my trip to 5 days, Multi-day hike
- `add_food`: Add 150 g of oat flakes to my trip food
- `get_totals`: How many calories per day is my trip food?
